Version 19.0.0 introduces a major cleanup and refactor.

- Removed multiple reference and template files to streamline the skill.

Version 18.0.0 introduces a major update with new references and improved workflows:

- Added 9 new reference files, including expanded bulk audit, e-commerce platform patterns, technical audit templates, and LLM crawler handling guides.
- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity, guidance, and updated storage phase from "optimize" to "tune."
- Enhanced pre-migration and bulk audit playbooks with additional workflows and template references.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Expanded documentation for AI crawler handling and platform-specific technical SEO checks.

- Updated storage and handoff summary paths in the Skill Contract section for improved clarity and file organization.

- Version updated to 16.0.0

- Version bump to 14.0.0.
- Updated metadata: version field is now 14.0.0 and the slug is set to "technical-seo-checker".
- No functional or instructional content changes; only SKILL.md metadata updated for versioning alignment.

Technical SEO Checker 13.0.0 — major update with clarified scope, improved workflows, and enhanced instructions.

- Clarifies skill purpose: strictly for technical SEO (crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structure, migrations)—not for content/on-page reviews.
- Streamlines instructions and data sources; adds precise guidance on metric labeling (Measured/User-provided/Estimated).
- Updates helper tool recipes, fallback methods, and instructions for validating fixes.
- Refines references, compatibility, and metadata fields.
- Removes obsolete files and mentions; all platform and connector links now use a unified local-relative format.
- Expanded contract with clearer definitions of audit finish criteria, outputs, and safety boundaries.

**Major upgrade: Version 3.0.0 expands coverage and reporting for all technical SEO checks.**

- Adds support for advanced Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP, TTFB), JavaScript rendering, redirect chains, canonical tags, hreflang, and structured data validation.
- Introduces a scored technical health report (0–100), critical/high/medium issue triage, and a prioritized implementation roadmap.
- Broader trigger and use-case coverage: now matches queries for robots.txt, XML sitemaps, HTTPS, JavaScript SEO, site health checks, and more.
- Enhanced compatibility details and optional tool integration notes.
- New example and template references included for technical audit outputs.

Version 2.0.0

- Major update with improved discoverability: added clear usage triggers and cross-skill references for related SEO tasks.
- Added author, version, license, and detailed metadata (tags, triggers) to the skill manifest.
- Linked to related skills for on-page and internal linking audits.
- Included references to new documentation: HTTP status codes and robots.txt reference files.
- Added a navigable library of 20 SEO/GEO skills in the docs.

- Added `geo-relevance: "low"` to skill metadata.
- Removed version field from SKILL.md frontmatter.
- Removed redundant documentation files: references/http-status-codes.md and references/robots-txt-reference.md.

- Added a version field ("1.0") to the SKILL.md metadata.
- No other functional or instructional changes; content and audit process remain the same.

Initial release of Technical SEO Checker – comprehensive technical SEO audit tool.

- Performs in-depth audits on site speed, crawlability, indexability, mobile-friendliness, security, and structured data.
- Identifies key technical issues impacting search performance.
- Provides audit templates and instructions for robots.txt, sitemap, Core Web Vitals, mobile optimization, and more.
- Works with either connected SEO tools or manual data input.
- Includes use cases, detailed instructions, and structured markdown output formats for all major technical SEO checks.
